summary: Iteration 5: AI patient personas, AI therapist personas, /api/personas/chat, /api/personas/chat/history, /api/personas/{id}/opener, and /api/reminders/status all verified backend + frontend. 14/14 pytest cases pass. Mobile UI testing on Community, Therapists, persona-chat, and Home screens all pass. Post-a-story modal opens and inputs render. AI patient cards navigate to /persona-chat?persona_id=pt_xxx and load opener bubble. Therapists tab shows 'AI early-access' banner, AI badges, and 'Chat with [first name]' CTA routing to persona-chat. Home renders cleanly without crash. Minor: web preview shows expected expo-notifications warning (unsupported on web) and React Native 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' style warning, plus expo SDK package version drift (expo@54.0.34 vs expected ~54.0.35, expo-font@14.0.11, expo-router@6.0.23). No deprecated-package usage detected (expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch).

react_native_issues.issue: Package versions out of sync with installed Expo SDK (expo@54.0.34 expected ~54.0.35, expo-font@14.0.11 expected ~14.0.12, expo-router@6.0.23 expected ~6.0.24). Run: cd /app/frontend && npx expo install --check
props.pointerEvents is deprecated in React Native. Move to style.pointerEvents. Likely in a Modal/Pressable wrapper used across screens (warning seen on Community/persona-chat load).

action_items: Run `npx expo install --check` (or `--fix`) in /app/frontend to align expo, expo-font, expo-router versions with SDK 54.
Search for `pointerEvents=` JSX prop usage and migrate to `style={{ pointerEvents: ... }}` (likely in a wrapper component used by Community/persona-chat).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single large file (>1700 lines). Consider splitting personas/therapists/reminders/community routes into separate routers for maintainability.
AI patient and therapist persona definitions are well-isolated and never leak persona_prompt in responses — verified.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_user story via POST /api/community/stories and TEST_p/TEST_t persona chat sessions; harmless test data persisted in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend BASE_URL is read via EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env (loaded via python-dotenv in test). All iteration-5 endpoints stable. /api/personas/chat enforces 404 on unknown persona_id. /api/reminders/status returns days_since_assessment, exercise_overdue, assessment_overdue, daily_reminder_text, weekly_reminder_text. Frontend tabs: Home, Community, Therapists, Hope.
